items.title: Abel
items.charge: Bringing the firstlings of his flock and the fat thereof

items.title: Abigail
items.charge: Keeping David from shedding blood and avenging himself with his own hand

items.title: Abraham
items.charge: Obeying the Lord's voice; keeping his charge, his commandments, his statutes, and his laws

items.title: Antipas, Smyrna, and Philadelphia
items.charge: Faithful unto death; keeping the word of his patience; not denying his name in the place where Satan's seat is

items.title: Asa in his first years
items.charge: Taking away the strange altars and the high places; commanding Judah to seek the Lord and do the law; crying to the Lord against a million Ethiopians

items.title: Barnabas
items.charge: Selling his land and laying the money at the apostles' feet; a good man, full of the Holy Ghost and of faith

items.title: Barzillai the Gileadite
items.charge: Bringing beds, wheat, and honey to the king and his hungry men in the wilderness at Mahanaim

items.title: Caleb and Joshua
items.charge: Wholly following the Lord when ten spies and the whole congregation would not

items.title: Cornelius
items.charge: A devout man, one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway

items.title: Daniel
items.charge: Purposing in his heart not to defile himself with the king's meat; praying three times a day with his windows open toward Jerusalem, decree or no decree

items.title: David
items.charge: A man after the Lord's own heart; keeping his commandments and following him with all his heart, save only in the matter of Uriah

items.title: Dorcas (Tabitha)
items.charge: Full of good works and almsdeeds which she did; the coats and garments she made for the widows

items.title: Ebed-melech the Ethiopian
items.charge: Going to the king for Jeremiah, and drawing him up out of the dungeon with old cast clouts and rotten rags

items.title: Eleazar the scribe
items.charge: Choosing to die gloriously rather than eat swine's flesh, or pretend to, at ninety years old

items.title: Enoch
items.charge: Walking with God three hundred years

items.title: Ezra
items.charge: Preparing his heart to seek the law of the Lord, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments

items.title: Gaius, the wellbeloved
items.charge: Walking in the truth; doing faithfully to the brethren and to strangers; bringing them forward on their journey after a godly sort

items.title: Gideon
items.charge: Throwing down the altar of Baal in his father's house; going against Midian with three hundred, as the Lord said

items.title: Hannah
items.charge: Praying in bitterness of soul, vowing a son to the Lord, and giving him when she had him

items.title: Hezekiah
items.charge: Trusting in the Lord God of Israel; cleaving to him and keeping his commandments; breaking the brasen serpent; keeping the passover; spreading Sennacherib's letter before the Lord

items.title: Isaac
items.charge: Dwelling in the land the Lord told him of, and not going down into Egypt in the famine

items.title: Israel at the first Passover
items.charge: Doing as the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron: the lamb, the blood on the door, the unleavened bread

items.title: Jael
items.charge: Blessed above women in the tent: the nail, the hammer, and Sisera

items.title: Jehoiada the priest
items.charge: Hiding the king's son six years from Athaliah; making a covenant between the Lord, the king, and the people; doing good in Israel, both toward God and toward his house

items.title: Jehoshaphat
items.charge: Seeking the Lord and walking in his commandments; sending Levites to teach the book of the law through all the cities of Judah; setting the battle in array with singers

items.title: Job
items.charge: Perfect and upright, fearing God and eschewing evil; sinning not with his lips in all his loss

items.title: Jonadab and the Rechabites
items.charge: Obeying the commandment of Jonadab their father for over two hundred years: no wine, no house, no vineyard, no field

items.title: Joseph
items.charge: Refusing his master's wife: how can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

items.title: Joseph, the husband of Mary
items.charge: A just man; doing as the angel of the Lord bade him, four times, without a word recorded

items.title: Josiah
items.charge: A tender heart at the reading of the book; turning to the Lord with all his heart, soul, and might, according to all the law of Moses

items.title: Jotham
items.charge: Preparing his ways before the Lord his God; not entering the temple as his father had

items.title: Judas Maccabeus
items.charge: Going to battle with prayer and the law, keeping the ordinances of war, and cleansing the sanctuary

items.title: Judith
items.charge: A widow who feared God greatly, fasting all the days of her widowhood; going out to Holofernes in the name of the Lord

items.title: Lot
items.charge: A righteous man vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked; sheltering the strangers at his door

items.title: Lydia
items.charge: A seller of purple who worshipped God; whose heart the Lord opened; who constrained the apostles to abide in her house

items.title: Mary of Bethany
items.charge: Sitting at his feet to hear his word; anointing his body aforehand to the burying

items.title: Mary, the mother of Jesus
items.charge: Be it unto me according to thy word; blessed is she that believed

items.title: Mattathias
items.charge: Zealous for the law: refusing the king's commandment at Modin, and executing the apostate on the altar as Phinehas did Zambri

items.title: Mordecai and Esther
items.charge: Mordecai: bowing not to Haman. Esther: going in to the king against the law, after three days' fast: if I perish, I perish

items.title: Moses
items.charge: Refusing to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter; faithful in all the Lord's house; very meek, above all the men upon the face of the earth

items.title: Naaman the Syrian
items.charge: Going down and dipping himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God, after his anger

items.title: Nehemiah
items.charge: Building the wall in fifty-two days with a sword in one hand; taking no governor's bread; forbidding usury; shutting the gates on the Sabbath; remember me, O my God, for good

items.title: Noah
items.charge: Doing according to all that God commanded him

items.title: Obed-edom the Gittite
items.charge: Keeping the ark of God in his house three months, after it had killed Uzzah

items.title: Onesiphorus
items.charge: Oft refreshing Paul, and not ashamed of his chain; seeking him out very diligently in Rome

items.title: Onias the high priest
items.charge: Godliness and hatred of wickedness, so that the laws were kept very well and the city lived in peace

items.title: Paul, at the end of his course
items.charge: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith

items.title: Phinehas
items.charge: Zealous for his God at Peor; making an atonement for the children of Israel

items.title: Rahab
items.charge: Receiving the spies with peace, and believing that the Lord had given Israel the land

items.title: Ruth and Boaz
items.charge: Ruth: cleaving to Naomi and to Naomi's God. Boaz: the law of gleaning, and the law of the kinsman, done to the letter

items.title: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego
items.charge: Refusing to fall down and worship the golden image; not careful to answer the king in this matter

items.title: Shiphrah and Puah, the midwives
items.charge: Fearing God and not doing as the king of Egypt commanded them

items.title: Simeon and Anna
items.charge: Just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel; a widow who departed not from the temple, serving God with fastings and prayers night and day

items.title: Solomon at Gibeon
items.charge: Asking for an understanding heart to judge the people, and not for long life, riches, or the life of his enemies

items.title: Stephen
items.charge: Full of faith and of the Holy Ghost; a face like an angel before the council; forgiving those who stoned him

items.title: Susanna
items.charge: Choosing to fall into the hands of the elders rather than sin in the sight of the Lord

items.title: The Bereans
items.charge: Receiving the word with all readiness of mind, and searching the scriptures daily, whether those things were so

items.title: The centurion of Capernaum
items.charge: Loving the nation and building the synagogue; not counting himself worthy that the Lord should come under his roof: speak the word only

items.title: The daughters of Zelophehad
items.charge: Asking rightly for their father's inheritance, and marrying within their tribe as commanded

items.title: The Philippian jailer
items.charge: Believing on the Lord with all his house the same night; washing the stripes of the men he had put in the stocks

items.title: The prophet's widow, and the pot of oil
items.charge: Borrowing not a few vessels, as the prophet said, and shutting the door

items.title: The Samaritan leper who returned
items.charge: One of ten: turning back to glorify God with a loud voice, and giving thanks at his feet

items.title: The seven brethren and their mother
items.charge: Refusing to taste swine's flesh under torture, seven times over, in hope of the resurrection

items.title: The Shunammite woman
items.charge: Constraining the man of God to eat bread; building him a little chamber on the wall, with a bed, a table, a stool, and a candlestick

items.title: The sons of Levi at the golden calf
items.charge: Answering, Who is on the Lord's side? and executing the sentence on their own brethren

items.title: The widow and her two mites
items.charge: Casting in all that she had, even all her living

items.title: The widow of Zarephath
items.charge: Making the prophet's cake first, out of the last handful of meal

items.title: The woman with the issue of blood
items.charge: Believing that if she might but touch his clothes she should be whole

items.title: Timothy, with Lois and Eunice
items.charge: Unfeigned faith that dwelt first in his grandmother and his mother; knowing the holy scriptures from a child

items.title: Tobit
items.charge: Walking in truth and justice all his days; alms, tithes, and burying the dead of his people at the risk of his own life

items.title: Zacharias and Elisabeth
items.charge: Both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless

items.title: Zerubbabel and Joshua the high priest
items.charge: Obeying the voice of the Lord by Haggai; rising up and working on the house of the Lord
